exposure: duration of starting breastfeeding after birth
cohort: Recently delivered mothers in the postnatal ward during the first 48 hours postpartum at a tertiary care hospital in Ahmedabad, India, who had a normal or cesarean delivery and provided written consent.
finding: Mothers' age, number of live births, and mixed feeding were statistically significantly associated with good attachment, while good positioning was statistically significantly correlated with less secretion of milk, and duration of starting breastfeeding after birth and breast pain were significantly associated with both good attachment and good positioning.
